info.name: XpertLink Messaging Chat Flow (Verified)
info.description:
Flow G: XprtLink chat is a Socket.IO / WebSocket protocol ONLY. The messaging-service exposes NO REST endpoints for conversations or messages (see services/messaging-service/src/routes/index.js and the socket events in sockets/messagingSocket.js: conversation:create, conversation:join, message:send, message:history, message:read). Postman/Newman cannot drive a Socket.IO handshake + ack-callback API, so this flow is validated by a socket.io-client driver instead of REST requests.

Run it with:
  pnpm --filter @xprtlink/backend flow:chat
  (or)  node scripts/flows/messaging-chat.socket.mjs [base_url]

The driver: registers a customer + expert (REST), onboards the expert, opens two authenticated sockets, then exercises conversation:create -> conversation:join -> message:send (both parties) -> message:read -> message:history -> conversation:list, asserting realtime message:new delivery. Exit code 0 = all assertions passed.
